content.what_it_is: MATLAB paper-figure script for the FUNWAVE-TVD vertical_velocity_structure case: compares the Boussinesq-reconstructed vertical profile of horizontal velocity u(z) against linear wave theory for three wave periods [2.5 3 6] s (L3) in a 1x3 subplot figure. Per period (L11): builds the case folder T<period>s (L13-L14), picks a sample x-index m0 (645 or 650; 1148 with files=[5] for the unused period 9 branch, L16-L34), loads dep.out (L37), and computes theory: amp=0.5, g=9.81, h=10.0 (L43-L45), angular frequency om=2*pi/T (L47-L48), wavenumber K from the external solver wvnum_omvec(h,om,g) (L49), kh (L52), zt=-[0:h] (L53), and u_theory=amp*om*cosh(kh+K.*zt)/sinh(kh) (L54). For snapshot files=[8] (L29, L58) it loads eta, mask, u, v, Ax, Ay, Bx, By ASCII fields (L62-L69) and reconstructs the vertical structure per the commented formula u(z)=(za-z)Ax+0.5(za^2-z^2)Bx (L71-L74): builds z_num=10 sigma levels z(l,:,:)=-dep*(l-1)/(z_num-1) (L77-L79), reference level za=-0.5528*dep+0.4472*eta (L81), then U(l,:,:)=u+(za-zl).*Ax+0.5*(za.^2-zl.^2).*Bx and analogous V (L82-L86). It plots U(:,n0,m0) vs z at row n0=25 (L88-L91) against u_theory(zt) (L99), axis [-0.3 1.3 -10 0] (L101), legend FUNWAVE/Theory on the first panel (L107-L109), title kh (L111), then makes a plots/ directory and prints plots/compare.jpg (L116-L119).
entities: script (no function declaration; top-level MATLAB script)
m0 — sampled x-index, period-dependent (L17, L21, L25, L32)
eta, mask, u, v, Ax, Ay, Bx, By — model output fields (L62-L69)
za — reference elevation for the quadratic profile (L81)

equations.ref: linear wave theory horizontal velocity profile
reference level z_alpha of the Boussinesq quadratic velocity profile
vertical reconstruction u(z)=(za-z)Ax+0.5(za^2-z^2)Bx per comment L72
vertical reconstruction of v per comment L73
10 evenly spaced sigma levels from surface to bottom

io.name: 1x3 panels of u(z) FUNWAVE vs theory, titled by kh

calls: wvnum_omvec (L49) — external function, not defined in this file
unresolved: wvnum_omvec (L49) is an external wavenumber solver not defined in this file; its location and algorithm are unknown from here.

The za coefficients -0.5528 and 0.4472 (L81) correspond to the FUNWAVE reference level z_alpha = zeta*h with zeta related to -0.531 (Nwogu-type); the exact provenance of these two decimals is not documented in the file.
The period 9 branch (L31-L34) sets m0=1148 and files=[5] but period=[2.5 3 6] (L3) never contains 9, so it is dead code from a previous configuration.
mask, v, and the reconstructed V are loaded/computed (L63, L65, L85) but never plotted.
Sample indices m0 (645/650) and n0=25 (L16-L26, L88) pick a specific gauge column; the physical location depends on the case grid, not derivable here.

u_theory omits the cos(phase) factor — it is the amplitude envelope of the linear profile; matching the snapshot at files=[8] assumes the wave crest is at the sampled location, which the file does not verify.
